theater: 宋兩淮沿邊與京西襄樊

battle.name: 仆散安貞攻宋之戰
battle.theater: 宋兩淮沿邊與京西襄樊
battle.brief: 一二二一年，蒙古遣契丹出身的將領仆散安貞率一路兵馬再入宋境，兵鋒指向河南、淮西與京西，與宋軍在兩淮、襄樊一線反覆交鋒。蒙古分兵抄掠、圍城掘塹，宋軍倚城固守，因補給耗盡與軍中疫癘而未能深入。卡面的希臘火代表這類燃燒兵器：宋人已有猛火油，蒙古則自中亞帶回火油與火藥的用法。

kit.name: 希臘火
kit.history: 配在銅管裡的燃燒劑。配方是帝國的機密，配方和船一起沉了。

countries: 交戰雙方是蒙古帝國與南宋，但戰線並非只擺在南北兩端。一二二一年的大蒙古國已從草原聯盟轉為常備軍制：千戶、百戶為基本編制，萬戶統兵，怯薛宿衛拱衛大汗，漢人與色目人組成的漢軍負責攻堅與工程；此時大汗成吉思汗正在西亞前線主持第一次西征，中原與漢地由太師木華黎經略，仆散安貞正是木華黎麾下握有獨立兵權的統兵之將。金朝仍在蔡州一線勉強支撐，另一端西夏已被蒙古打得只剩附庸，第三方的存在使宋蒙之間每一次試探都帶著借刀與防範的意味。南宋一方是典型的守勢部署：京西南路的襄樊、隨州與河南一線由孟宗政等沿邊守將主持，兩淮的楚州、泰州、海州一線由趙方鎮守，朝廷以樞密院調度各路兵馬，以沿邊軍、鄉兵與義軍構成梯次，配備弩砲、火油與拒馬等守城器材。雙方的編制其實顯出同一趨勢：蒙古靠漢人攻城技術補上攻堅的短板，宋靠弩砲與火器補上野戰的短板。
countriesEn: The two belligerents were the Mongol Empire and the Southern Song, but the front was not laid out simply along a north-south line. By 1221 the Great Mongol state had passed from a tribal confederation to a standing military system: the thousand-household and hundred-household as the base units, ten-thousand-household commanders in the field, the keshig guard attending the Great Khan, and a Han Chinese and Sartaid Han army responsible for siege work and engineering. The Great Khan himself was then in the field in western Asia directing the first western campaign, while China proper was administered by the Taishi Muqali, and Pusang Anzhen was precisely one of the commanders under him who held independent troops. The Jin still survived on a narrow basis around Caizhou, Xixia had been reduced to vassalage by the Mongols, and the presence of these third parties gave every probe between Song and Mongol the character of a manoeuvre that might use one neighbour against another. The Song side was organised as a purely defensive deployment: the Xiangfan, Suizhou and Henan line of the Jingxi west circuit lay under frontier commanders such as Meng Zongzheng, while Chuizhou, Taizhou and Haizhou on the two Huai were held by Zhao Fang; the court moved the troops of the circuits through the Bureau of Military Affairs and built a graded defence out of frontier garrisons, militia and volunteer bands, equipped with crossbow artillery, fire oil and chevaux-de-frise for the walls. On both sides the same tendency showed itself: the Mongols compensated for their weakness in siege work with Han Chinese engineers, and the Song compensated for its weakness in the field with crossbow artillery and fire weapons.
people: 關鍵人物是仆散安貞與宋方沿線的守將。仆散安貞的姓氏仆散出自契丹舊族，一般認為他是契丹人，早年已內附蒙古，名字同時見於蒙古與金兩方面的編年；在金人筆下，他是領兵入宋的統帥，在蒙古方面則是木華黎手下可以獨當一路的將領，一二二一年受命率兵再攻宋境。蒙古內部此時的權力重心已分：成吉思汗與次子察合台在東西兩線爭雄，朮赤公開抗命，拖雷與速不台遠在阿姆河一帶，中原的調兵之權握在木華黎手中，這一點直接決定了仆散安貞只能以偏師深入宋境。宋方方面，楚州守將趙方是兩淮防線的樞紐，他以有限兵力守重城、屢挫蒙古偏師，嘉定十四年（一二二一年）病卒於任上，兵權由其子趙葵接替；京西的孟宗政則以襄樊、隨州為根據地，維持住漢水兩岸的防線。朝廷層面，寧宗趙擴在位，相國史彌遠主持政務，面對蒙古借道與輸糧的要求一律拒絕，這一決策使金朝失去南面的依托，也讓宋蒙之間的衝突延續了下去。
peopleEn: The key figures are Pusang Anzhen himself and the Song commanders holding the line. The surname Pusang belongs to the old Khitan clans, and Pusang Anzhen is generally held to have been a Khitan who entered Mongol service early; his name appears in the chronicles of both the Mongols and the Jin. To Jin writers he was a commander who led troops into Song territory, and to the Mongols he was a leader under Muqali capable of commanding a column on his own; in 1221 he was ordered to attack Song territory again. The centre of power inside the empire was itself divided: the Great Khan and his second son Chagatai were competing in the east and the west, Jochi was openly in defiance of his father's commands, and Tolui and Subutai were far away on the Amu Darya, while the power of raising troops in China remained in Muqali's hands. That single fact explains why Pusang Anzhen could only penetrate Song territory with a detached force. On the Song side Zhao Fang, defender of Chuizhou, was the pivot of the Huai line: he held a major city with limited forces, repeatedly checked Mongol detachments, and fell sick and died in his post in 1221, his command passing to his son Zhao Kui. In the west Meng Zongzheng used Xiangfan and Suizhou as his base and kept the line alive on both banks of the Han river. At court, with Emperor Ningzong on the throne and the chancellor Shi Miyuan in charge, every Mongol request for a right of passage and for grain was refused; that decision left the Jin without support in the south, and it also ensured that the Song-Mongol conflict would outlast the year.
kits: 卡面上的希臘火是拜占庭帝國的液態燃燒兵器：銅管內盛配方秘傳的燃燒劑，點火之後噴射出去，覆蓋水面仍可燃燒。拜占庭自七世紀末即以敕令把配方列為機密，洩露者處死；其使用見於公元六七八年的海上戰役與七一七年至七一八年的君士坦丁堡圍城，直到一二〇四年第四次十字軍攻君士坦丁堡時仍見於記載，歷數百年而配方始終不外洩。東亞並無這一套銅管噴射器，但同一原理的燃燒劑在中國確實存在：宋人稱猛火油，一一六一年采石之戰中，虞允文所部即以猛火油澆灌焚燒金軍戰船，《宋史·兵志》又把猛火油櫃列入常備器械，以皮囊盛油、銅管噴出再以火引燃。蒙古這邊銅管暫缺，替代品是火車、火牛與附油火箭一類火攻器材；攻城器械則以雲梯、權杆、穴地與配重投石車為主，工程多由降附的漢人與色目工匠操辦。值得留意的是，蒙古自一二一九年起的西征正穿行於產出石油的波斯與美索不達米亞一帶，阿拉伯地理書記載巴格達市場有火油出售，火油與火藥的用法很可能隨西征隊伍東來，數十年後成為攻襄樊、攻釣魚城的火器技術底子。這場戰役的殘存編年並沒有寫下希臘火式銅管器具的使用記錄，卡面兵器在此代表的是同類燃燒技術的譜系。
kitsEn: The Greek fire on the card is the Byzantine liquid incendiary: a burning mixture, its recipe a state secret, carried in bronze pipes and squirted out when lit, so that it burned even as it spread over the surface of water. Byzantium had sealed the formula under imperial decree since the end of the seventh century, with death the penalty for disclosure; its use is recorded in a naval battle of 678 and in the defence of Constantinople between 717 and 718, and it still appears in the accounts of the Fourth Crusade assault on Constantinople in 1204, so that the formula survived for several hundred years without leaking. East Asia had no bronze siphon, but the same principle existed there under another name: the Song called it fierce fire oil, and at the battle of Caishi in 1161 the troops under Yu Yunwen used it to douse and burn the Jin war-ships; the History of Song in its treatise on the military lists the fierce-fire-oil chest among the standard equipment, a leather bag of oil with a bronze pipe that spouts the liquid out to be set alight. On the Mongol side there was as yet no siphon, and the substitutes were the fire cart, the fire ox and incendiary arrows; the siege equipment proper consisted of scaling ladders, pole-arms, mine tunnels and counterweight trebuchets, and the engineering was done mostly by Han Chinese and Sartaid craftsmen who had surrendered and joined. It is worth noting that the Mongol western campaign from 1219 ran through Persia and Mesopotamia, the very regions that produced petroleum, and that Arab geographical works record oil of fire being sold in the markets of Baghdad; the use of burning oil and of gunpowder was very likely carried east with the campaigning columns, and decades later became the technical base of the fire weapons used against Xiangfan and Diaoyucheng. The fragmentary chronicles of this campaign do not record the use of a siphon device of the Greek fire type; the weapon on the card stands here for the lineage of that family of burning techniques.
tactics: 蒙古的戰法仍以草原騎兵為骨幹：分進合擊，遠距離迂回，避開宋軍集結之處，專打沿邊縣城與渡口，逼宋方各處馳援，再用疾馳的騎兵在野地收拾潰散之師。轉入攻堅時便換成工程手段，先以弓騎覆蓋城頭火力，再以雲梯、權杆、填壕板接近城牆，或掘地道以火藥崩塌牆基，同時以火車、火牛焚燒城門與糧秫陣；被俘的降軍常被驅在前面填壕。攻城不成則退回騎兵機動，繼續切斷漕運與糧道。宋軍的防禦是典型的江南式縱深堡寨與城池體系：城頭以弩砲與床子弩作長程打擊，弓手分番輪射，牆下設陷坑與拒馬槊，城內縱深屯兵，等蒙古營壘疲憊或馬匹缺草時出城夜襲燒營，或派水軍控制漢水、淮河渡口，切斷浮橋與糧船。兩軍勝負的關鍵因此不在一城一地的得失，而在誰能先把糧草與馬料接上：蒙古騎兵利於速戰卻最怕斷糧，宋軍城池糧道依漕運而通，卻因兵額分散而難以集中出擊。
tacticsEn: The Mongol way of fighting still had cavalry for its backbone: to strike in divided columns, to move by long encirclement, to avoid where the Song had concentrated, to hit the frontier counties and ferry crossings, to force the Song to send help to every point, and then to gather up broken formations in the open with fast-moving horse. When it came to storming a city the method changed to engineering: first the mounted archers put the wall-top fire under cover, then scaling ladders, pole-arms and plank-filled ditches were brought up to the rampart, or a tunnel was driven under the wall and the base brought down with gunpowder, while fire carts and fire oxen were set against the gates and the magazines. Captured men were often driven forward to fill the ditches. Where the assault failed the column withdrew into the saddle and went on cutting the river traffic and the supply roads. The Song defence was the typical southern system of stockades and cities in depth: crossbow artillery and bed crossbows on the walls for long-range fire, archers shooting in relief, pits and caltrops and wooden chevaux-de-frise below the walls, and troops held in depth inside the city, ready to sally out at night and burn the Mongol camp when the enemy works were tired or the horses short of fodder, or to send the river fleet to hold the crossings of the Han and the Huai and cut the pontoon bridges and grain boats. The outcome therefore turned not on the loss of any one town but on who could first bring up grain and fodder: Mongol horse was at its best in a short war and worst of all when its supply was cut, and while the Song cities could be provisioned by water, their strength was so dispersed that it could never be concentrated for a counter-stroke.
data: 可核對的數字有限，但仍有幾項可用。蒙古方面，一二一九年第一次西征出動的總兵力，學界一般估在十五萬至二十萬之間，其中蒙古騎兵不足一半，其餘是漢軍與各附庸部眾；西征分出拖雷、察合台、速不台數路，主力被抽往西亞與中亞，中原能動用的兵馬有限，故一二二一年入宋之師只能以一路偏師的規模出現。距離上，自蒙古在中原的前進基地到楚州一線，騎兵行程近兩千里，遠征隊伍往返需以月計；自蔡州到襄樊約五百里，正是蒙古從正面與側面同時施壓金朝與宋朝時必須維持的聯繫地帶。器械方面，蒙古倚重配重投石車，其攻城砲的射程在後來的元史中有「所及幾二里」的記載，雖屬一二八〇年前後的較大砲型，仍可作為同類機制的參照；宋方的攻城重器以霹靂砲與床子弩為主，《宋史》記襄樊一帶城上弩砲以數百計，另有神臂弓有效射程約二百步。希臘火一系的數字則年代久遠而明確：拜占庭以敕令封存配方的時間在公元六七七年至六七八年前後，首次大規模使用的海上戰役見於六七八年，一二〇四年仍有使用記載，跨越五百餘年。至於本役雙方的確切兵力、陣亡與器械損失，現存宋、金、蒙三方面編年均無可靠記載，只能由「蒙古軍未能攻下楚州、襄樊等主要城池」這一結果反推其攻勢未竟。
dataEn: The verifiable figures are few, but a few can be given. On the Mongol side, the total force sent out in the first western campaign from 1219 is generally put by scholars at between one hundred and fifty thousand and two hundred thousand, of whom the Mongol horse proper was less than half, the rest being Han Chinese troops and the contingents of the vassals; that expedition was split between the columns of Tolui, Chagatai and Subutai, so that the main strength was drawn off towards western and central Asia and only limited forces remained in China for use against Song. The Mongol detachments operating in 1221 were therefore no more than one column apiece. In distance terms, a mounted column moving from the Mongol base in the plains to the line of Chuizhou covered close to two thousand li, and a far-ranging force needed months to move out and back; from Caizhou to Xiangfan is about five hundred li, and that was precisely the corridor the Mongols had to keep open in order to press the Jin from the front and the Song from the flank at the same time. As for equipment, the Mongols relied on the counterweight trebuchet, and the range of their siege artillery is given in the later Yuan history as reaching a matter of two li, which belongs to the larger cannon of around 1280 but serves as a reference for the same mechanism. On the Song side the wall artillery consisted chiefly of the thunder-crash trebuchet and the bed crossbow, the History of Song recording several hundred pieces of crossbow artillery on the walls around Xiangfan, together with the shenpi bow of an effective range of about two hundred paces. The figures belonging to the Greek fire line are ancient but firm: Byzantium sealed the formula by decree around 677-678, its first large-scale use is recorded in a naval battle of 678, and it was still in use in 1204, a span of more than five hundred years. As for the exact strengths, casualties and equipment losses of this campaign, no reliable figures survive in the chronicles of Song, Jin or Mongol, and all that can be inferred from the result is that the offensive remained unfinished, since neither Chuizhou nor Xiangfan fell.
cause: 打起來的根由有兩層。表層是宋蒙之間早已存在的邊境衝突：蒙古以中原為基地南下，必須打通山東、河南與兩淮之間的運輸線，而南宋自靖康之後視蒙古為世仇，既不願割地輸幣，也不肯供應糧食與借道。一二一八年蒙古遣使到宋，提出借道攻金並索取糧食，朝廷議而不決，最終拒絕，蒙古隨即以兵相見；一二一九年那次攻宋因糧草不濟與軍中疫癘而退兵，幾乎同時成吉思汗在西線開啟西征，東線的兵力與戰略縱深都被吸走，兩面作戰之下，蒙古在宋境內只能做有限度的抄掠與施壓。一二二一年木華黎重新調兵，仆散安貞受命再攻，戰事遂沿兩淮與京西同時展開。深層則是三方互相利用的困局：金哀宗退守蔡州，急需南面的糧援與通道；南宋擔心一旦助金聯蒙古，金朝在河南的殘餘兵力就會重新威脅江淮；西夏被蒙古追打，只能順從。於是宋不肯救金，蒙古則利用宋的拒絕削弱金的南翼，把攻宋變成壓金的手段之一。對宋廷而言，這又是北面同時受敵的一年：主力既要防金防西夏，還要對付這支新型的草原騎兵，取捨極為困難。
causeEn: There were two levels to the fighting. On the surface lay a frontier conflict that had existed between Song and Mongol for years: with the plains as a base, the Mongols had to open the transport lines linking Shandong, Henan and the two Huai, and the Southern Song, since the Jingkang disaster, regarded the Mongols as hereditary enemies, willing neither to cede land nor to pay silver, and unwilling either to supply grain or to grant a right of passage. In 1218 the Mongols sent envoys to Song to ask for passage against the Jin together with grain; the court debated and in the end refused, and the Mongols answered with troops. The attack of 1219 was broken off because supplies ran short and sickness spread through the army, and at almost the same moment the Great Khan opened the western campaign in the west, drawing away both the troops and the reach of the Mongols, so that with fighting on two fronts they could only raid and press inside Song territory to a limited degree. In 1221 Muqali redistributed the troops, Pusang Anzhen was ordered to attack again, and the war opened along the two Huai and in Jingxi at the same time. Deeper down lay a three-cornered trap in which each party tried to use the others: Jin Aizong had fallen back on Caizhou and needed grain and a corridor from the south; the Song feared that if it aided Jin against the Mongols, the surviving Jin forces in Henan would turn once more against the Jiang-Huai; and Xixia, harried by the Mongols, could only obey. The Song therefore would not rescue Jin, and the Mongols used that refusal to weaken the Jin southern flank, turning the attack on Song into one of the means of pressing Jin. For the Song court this was another year of pressure from the north: the main forces had to hold against Jin and Xixia and against a new kind of steppe cavalry at the same time, and the choices to be made were extremely difficult.
impact: 這場戰役的直接戰果有限，長遠的影響卻不小。對蒙古而言，一二二一年在兩淮與京西的攻勢第一次讓他們摸到南宋國防的實地：宋軍的城池依險而築，糧道接漕運，弩砲與火油同列守城，攻城遠比北方草原與中原城池艱難，騎兵速戰的傳統打法在城牆前屢屢受挫。這一課直接催生了後來蒙古對南方城池的專門攻城體系：蒙古調集回回砲師與漢人、降人工程隊，築造可以越城而過的攻城台與可俯射的高台，組織火藥與火油的火器隊，並在作戰中大量吸收南宋的工匠與降將。火油與火藥的技術也正是在西征中亞的經歷裡被蒙古人重新認識的，日後成為攻襄樊、攻釣魚城的常備手段。對南宋而言，這場戰役迫得朝廷把兩淮與襄樊的地位從一般邊州提升為根本重鎮，京西的軍制、糧運與城防在趙葵、孟珙等人主持下重新整頓，弩兵、砲手與火油器材開始被正式編入沿邊編制，邊軍的戰法也從純守城轉向以小股騎兵出擊、反游騎破敵。更大的格局轉變則在三年之後：金朝於一二三四年覆亡，南宋失去了北面的屏障，蒙古得以全力南向，這場戰役可以說是那個轉變的起點之一。
impactEn: The immediate results of the campaign were limited, but its longer consequences were not. For the Mongols, the offensive of 1221 in the two Huai and in Jingxi was the first time they could feel the Song defence in the flesh: Song cities were built on difficult ground, their supply lines ran on the water, and crossbow artillery and fire oil stood side by side on the walls, so that taking a city was far harder than in the northern steppe or in the plains of north China, and the old cavalry way of fighting by speed was repeatedly frustrated at the ramparts. That lesson directly produced the specialised siege system the Mongols later built for southern cities: they brought in trebuchet masters from the west together with Han Chinese and surrendered engineers, built siege towers that could reach over the walls and tall platforms from which to shoot down into the city, organised corps of fire weapons using gunpowder and burning oil, and took in large numbers of Song craftsmen and deserters. It was the experience of Central Asia during the western campaign that led the Mongols to rediscover the use of burning oil and gunpowder, and these became standard equipment in the sieges of Xiangfan and Diaoyucheng. For the Song, the campaign forced the court to raise the two Huai and Xiangfan from ordinary frontier posts to the status of strategic pivots; the military system, the grain transport and the city works of Jingxi were reorganised under Zhao Kui and Meng Gong, crossbowmen, artillery crews and the stores of fire oil were formally entered in the frontier establishments, and the frontier armies moved from a purely defensive posture towards sending out small bodies of horse to strike and roaming the country to break up the enemy. The larger change in the pattern came three years later: the Jin fell in 1234, the Song lost its northern shield, and the Mongols were free to drive south in earnest. This campaign can be counted as one of the starting points of that turn.
result: 就一場戰役的結果而言，蒙古沒有得手。一二二一年仆散安貞所部在兩淮與京西同時施壓，沿邊若干縣城一度失守，但宋軍在楚州、襄樊、隨州等要點上的抵抗奏效，蒙古軍既未攻下楚州，也未拿下襄樊；加之一二一九年那次的教訓——遠離牧場、糧草不濟、又逢軍中疫癘——這支深入宋境的偏師在秋冬之前退回了北方。仆散安貞本人仍留在蒙古軍中效力，日後在攻金、攻宋的戰線上繼續出現，其卒年不詳。這一役留下的最大成果是經驗：蒙古由此明白宋國不易速取，必須改以工程、砲石與火器配合的攻城法，並且在人員與物資上倚賴漢人；宋廷則明白北方再無可倚之屏障，把襄樊與兩淮的守備從邊防工事提升為國策，兩淮兵力的增募與轉制、京西漕運的整頓都始於此際。從更長的視角看，蒙古人沒有從楚州與襄樊拿到任何東西，但正因為攻不下這兩處，日後才把兵力集中於一二三一年的假道入宋與一二三四年滅金，再把南宋留給自己的後人來收拾。
resultEn: As the outcome of a single campaign, the Mongols did not succeed. In 1221 the troops of Pusang Anzhen pressed on the two Huai and in Jingxi at once and took some frontier counties for a time, but the Song resistance at Chuizhou, Xiangfan, Suizhou and other key points held, and the Mongols captured neither Chuizhou nor Xiangfan; with the lesson of 1219 before them, distance from the pastures, short supplies and sickness in the army, the column that had penetrated Song territory withdrew north before winter. Pusang Anzhen himself remained in Mongol service and reappeared on the fronts against Jin and Song in later years; his year of death is not recorded. The greatest product of the campaign was experience. The Mongols learned that the Song could not be taken by speed, that siege work had to be rebuilt around engineers, stone and fire, and that men and supplies had to lean on the Han Chinese; the Song court learned that there was no longer any shield in the north, and lifted the defence of Xiangfan and the two Huai from frontier works to national policy, with the raising and reorganisation of the Huai armies and the overhaul of the Jingxi grain transport beginning at this time. In the longer view the Mongols got nothing out of Chuizhou or Xiangfan, but precisely because those two places could not be taken they concentrated their forces instead on passing through Song territory in 1231 and on the destruction of Jin in 1234, leaving the Song itself to be settled by their own descendants.
